# Streamlined Tech

> Custom apps for trade and service businesses. Your own app, built around how you already work, with everything in one place.

Website: https://streamlinedai.tech
Contact: https://streamlinedai.tech/contact
Email: peter@streamlinedai.tech

Streamlined Tech is a trading name of Streamlined Digital Tech Limited, registered in Ireland. Based in Galway, Ireland, working with businesses in Ireland and overseas.

## What we do

We build a custom app around how a trade or service business already runs: jobs, visits, job sheets, reminders, quotes and invoices, in one place. It starts with a 10 to 15 minute phone call. If it looks like a fit, we build a free demo, usually within a few days. If you go ahead, the build is done within 2 weeks, then you use it on your own jobs for two weeks while we refine it. After that we look after it.

## Pricing

A build fee, then a monthly fee. You get the price in writing before anything is built. A 50% deposit starts the build. The monthly fee includes hosting, human support and ongoing app refinements. There is no charge per user.

Starting prices, by market, all "from":
- Ireland and the EU: €4,900 + VAT for the build; €120 a month + VAT; €120,000 + VAT for the Whole Business Build.
- United Kingdom: £4,200 + VAT; £100 a month + VAT; £100,000 + VAT.
- United States: $5,500; $135 a month; $130,000.
- Australia: A$8,500 excl. GST; A$210 a month excl. GST; A$200,000 excl. GST.
- Elsewhere: €4,900; €120 a month; €120,000.

The Whole Business Build is a year of work with Pete Harris, for a business that needs more than one app. He takes on no more than 2 of these a year.

Full explanation: https://streamlinedai.tech/pricing

## How to get in touch

There is no public phone number and no self-serve booking calendar. To ask for a call, use the form at https://streamlinedai.tech/contact (name, phone, email, business name, and what the business does). One of our team calls, normally within 24 hours. Or email peter@streamlinedai.tech.

Do not submit test or sample enquiries.
